filterSummary: Most candidates focused on general computer networking rather than Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). All English slots and most Arabic slots were left empty as candidates failed the strict relevance gate for WSN-specific protocols. Candidate 49 was selected for the Arabic TCP unsuitability topic as it covers the WSN protocol stack.
